entries.name: The toll office on the spit

norms.text: Each boat is written on the slate, in one column for Thorn and one for Hissmir.
The toll box is carried up from the spit at dusk.
The toll hands sweep the shrine at the boardwalk's end each morning.

taboos.text: Leaving the slate unwatched on the spit.

contempts.text: Captains who argue the toll after their boat is written.

faction.text: The toll office keeps the levy for the state until the dispute is settled.

work.text: We call the toll from the spit. No boat passes without paying.

trade.text: The levy on the pilgrim water is a fair price for safe water.

addressTerms.text: Captain, for whoever stands in the stern.

neverSaid.text: The sum of the slate's two columns.

grievances.text: Agents from Thorn and stewards from Hissmir both come to the spit to read the slate.
